description: Unit: quoteLifecycleEventFor maps every status pair in QUOTE_ALLOWED_STATUS_TRANSITIONS plus converted->accepted(system) to the right event or null; non-status updates and draft/pending_approval transitions yield null
DB integration: client-portal accept publishes exactly one QUOTE_ACCEPTED after commit with common fields, CONTACT actor and selected optional item ids; a rolled-back accept publishes nothing
DB integration: first portal view publishes QUOTE_VIEWED, a second view does not; send publishes QUOTE_SENT, resend does not
DB integration: expire-on-read and the expiry job racing on one sent quote produce one status change and one QUOTE_EXPIRED

DB integration: invoice-only conversion publishes QUOTE_CONVERTED with invoiceId; deleting the draft invoice publishes QUOTE_CONVERSION_REVERTED and returns status to accepted; re-converting publishes a second QUOTE_CONVERTED (distinct idempotency key)
DB integration: creating a revision of an accepted quote publishes QUOTE_SUPERSEDED on the old version with supersededByQuoteId
DB integration: workflow crm.send_quote via crmWorkerDal publishes QUOTE_SENT; linking a sent quote to an opportunity publishes no quote event
Contract: quote status write-path ledger covers every file writing quotes.status
Contract: workflow event contracts validate builder output for every QUOTE_* against catalog schemas; catalog seed migration rows match workflowEventCatalog.ts
Extend eventRegistry.contract.test: quote.* present in REST enum, OpenAPI enum, GET /webhooks/events and admin listing; legacy names still inert
Unit: entity subscriber for quote builds data with carried fields snake-cased, applies payload_fields.quote allowlist keeping quote_id, and matches event_filter.entity_ids on quote_id or client_id
Sink E2E (extend entityWebhooks.sinkE2E.integration.test.ts): accepting a quote delivers a signed quote.accepted to an HTTP sink
UI contract (extend AdminWebhooksSetup.ui.contract.test): quote events and Quote payload-field group render; every locale has the quote field labels
